name: Relationship With God
overview: Scripture reveals that a genuine relationship with God is founded on His love demonstrated through the giving of His only Son, Jesus Christ, so that believers may receive eternal life. Jesus declares Himself as the exclusive way to the Father, emphasizing that no one can come to God except through Him. This relationship is initiated by God's grace, shown in Christ's sacrificial death for sinners, and is personal and intimate, as Jesus invites individuals to open their hearts to Him, promising fellowship and communion.
